info.name: Storage Usage API
info.summary: Public API for total and configurable folder storage usage
info.description:
Provides a read-only JSON endpoint with the total storage usage of all known Nextcloud users and optional, separately configured folder sizes.
Values are returned in bytes and in the selected output units. Results use the configurable local cache. The app uses Nextcloud's file cache and does not scan the storage recursively.
**Privacy notice:** After the app is enabled, the endpoint is publicly accessible without authentication. It exposes the total usage plus the configured JSON keys and folder usage values. Choose non-sensitive JSON keys. Internal folder paths, usernames, user/file/storage IDs, file names, and file contents are never returned by the public endpoint.
info.author: kstraessler
